name: airship_aurora
title: AURORA Airship (AS800 class)
docs_note: Its envelope is that of the AURORA robotic airship, an Airspeed Airships AS800 (de Paiva et al., [Project AURORA](https://doi.org/10.1002/rob.20111), Journal of Field Robotics 23, 2006: 10.5 m x 3.0 m, 34 m³), drawn as the spheroid of the same volume and fineness; the pods, fins and masses follow this family's rules, not that vehicle.
notes: de Paiva, Azinheira, Ramos, Moutinho, Bueno 2006, J. Field Robotics 23(3/4):201-222, DOI 10.1002/rob.20111: 10.5 x 3.0 m, 34 m^3, payload about 10 kg, max about 14 m/s (50 km/h), two vectored propellers (-30..+120 deg, one group), X tail (+-30 deg), stern thruster; Moutinho et al. 2016 (Control Eng. Practice, DOI 10.1016/j.conengprac.2016.02.009) the same vehicle. Here the spheroid of the same volume and fineness (9.27 x 2.65 m), independent +-180 deg pods, '+' fins by the stability rule (no fin data published). ASSUMED: thrust 25 N per pod (max about 13.9 m/s on the drag set), masses (gondola 30.9 kg keeps the envelope at 0.1312 kg/m^2).
